environment.description: EKS pod in namespace 'data-plane-hardened' with identical application code. Pod spec drops CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN. Istio sidecar injected with PeerAuthentication policy requiring mTLS STRICT mode on the namespace. Additionally, an Istio AuthorizationPolicy resource is applied that enforces request-level JWT validation via RequestAuthentication with 'forwardOriginalToken: true' and jwtRules specifying ONLY 'RS256' in fromHeaders, effectively rejecting any token not signed with RS256 before it reaches the application container. The RequestAuthentication resource references the same JWKS endpoint but with an explicit 'outputClaimToHeaders' mapping that strips and re-validates the alg field. EnvoyFilter at the sidecar level applies a Lua script that inspects the JWT header and returns 403 if alg != 'RS256'. The pod also has a NetworkPolicy restricting ingress to only the istio-ingressgateway pods on port 50051.

config.envoy_filter_lua: function envoy_on_request(handle) local auth = handle:headers():get('authorization'); if auth then local token = auth:sub(8); local dot1 = token:find('.'); local header = token:sub(1, dot1-1); local decoded = handle:base64Decode(header); if not decoded:find('"alg":"RS256"') then handle:respond({[':status']='403'}, 'Forbidden: invalid algorithm'); end; end; end
